# agyn_app (Resource)

Manages an Agyn app.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "agyn_organization" "example" {
  name = "example-org"
}

resource "agyn_app" "example" {
  organization_id = agyn_organization.example.id
  slug            = "example-app"
  name            = "Example App"
  visibility      = "internal"
  description     = "Example app managed by Terraform."
  permissions     = ["agents:read"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) App name.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization identifier for the app.
- `slug` (String) App slug.
- `visibility` (String) Visibility for the app (public or internal).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description.
- `icon` (String) Icon URL or identifier.
- `permissions` (List of String) Permissions granted to the app.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the app.
- `identity_id` (String) Identity identifier for the app.
- `service_token` (String, Sensitive) Service token for the app.
